definitions.explanation: The source or beginning of something; where something came from.

examples.japanese: この{言葉|ことば}の{由来|ゆらい}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To research the origin of this word.

examples.japanese: その{祭|まつ}りには{古|ふる}い{由来|ゆらい}がある。
examples.english: That festival has an ancient history.

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}の{由来|ゆらい}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me the origin of the name.

notes:
{由来|ゆらい} refers to the origin, history, or story behind something — how a name, custom, place, or thing came to be.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {由来|ゆらい}する: to derive from, to originate from
- 〜に{由来|ゆらい}する: to originate in/from ~
- {名前|なまえ}の{由来|ゆらい}: the origin of a name
- {地名|ちめい}の{由来|ゆらい}: the origin of a place name
- {由来|ゆらい}を{持|も}つ: to have an origin/history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {由来|ゆらい}: origin, derivation (how something came to be)
- {起源|きげん}: origin (more scientific/formal, e.g., origin of life)
- {語源|ごげん}: etymology (specifically word origins)
- {来歴|らいれき}: history, career (of a person or thing)

NOTE:
Can also function as an adverb meaning "originally" or "by nature": {由来|ゆらい}{日本|にほん}は{島国|しまぐに}である (Japan is by nature an island nation). This usage is literary.
